findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure use of subprocess in google-auth
 * @description Detects use of subprocess functions that may execute external commands.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/google-auth/subprocess-use
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("^google/auth/.*") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "subprocess call in google-auth package; ensure arguments are not influenced by untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: google-auth may invoke subprocess with user-influenced data, leading to command injection.
